reason: Machine lens. Every opcode exists on the 65SC12: CPY #imm, BEQ/BNE/BCC, BRA, STZ zp, TRB zp, LDA #/STA zp. No bit ops, no WAI/STP. All ds_*/dm_*/b_ptr operands are zero page (listing: ds_clip &51, dm_jmin &5A, dm_jmax &5C, ds_n &68, dm_slot &58). Recount for the shipping layout (ren_draw_sprite &9B31, generic &9B75 -> &9B79, everything in page &9B): unclipped with Y=0 goes from 76 to 46 cycles (-30: the JSR plus raise_address's fast path is 32 and becomes CPY+BEQ taken, 5; the clip test is 19 for 22). Unclipped with Y!=0 and n<jmax costs 1 more (51+R for 50+R). With n=jmax it costs 1 less. Clipped parts cost 2 less (jmin!=0: 46+R for 48+R; n>jmax: 52+R for 54+R). With Y=0 on 44% of calls, that averages 0.44*30 - 0.56*1 = 12.6 a call, as claimed. Bytes: the old code is 57 bytes from LDA straight_sprite_hi to LDA dm_slot, the new 61 (+4; the claim says -4 saved, which matches). Branch ranges: BRA generic is &3B forward, and BCC/BNE rds_clip_g32 is about -&33. The C sense is right: CMP ds_n with A=jmax gives C=1 when n<=jmax, the old BCC/BEQ no_clip. The window has no self-modified operands. raise_address's lo_imm and rows_imm stay where they are and are written only by raise_address itself. The 4-byte slide of bank 4 from &9B75 to the tables after render_end (no ALIGN in between) moves these page crossings (static check of the listing): BCS up_in_ring &9BF8 (draw_column's up_cell, taken whenever there is no wrap) now crosses a page, +1 a raised cell. BEQ no_part &9DD0 +1 when taken. BEQ out &A2F7 +1. BEQ in_hazel &9CFC -1 (HAZEL compiled kinds). BEQ gathered &9EFD -1. LDA straight_sprite_hi,X (&A4E4 -> &A4E8) crosses from X=&18, not &1C, so sprites &18-&1B pay +1. The (col_ptr),Y reads of bank 4's straight sprite data also shift by 4. These are not in the 12.6. However, the bench build (debug_lives) has a byte-identical bank 4 layout to the shipping build (the listings' &9B00-&A5FF diff is empty), and its measured -42/-50 a pass includes all of them. So the net saving holds, and the claim's 'shipping layout not measured' is moot.
